name: hevcSoftware
description: A software HEVC decoder, used only when Apple's decoder refuses a stream (Apple first: the engine asks VideoToolbox for every HEVC track; typically HEVC 4:2:2 and 4:4:4 on chips without that support). Such video plays on the software path. Opt-in, in the `extended-plus` variant. Switched on by the app's owner on 2026-11-12 with the risk accepted, not after a lawyer's opinion (RESEARCH.md section 3.2, point 8).

hevc.note: fallback only, when Apple's decoder refuses the stream; HEVC pools (Access Advance, VCL Advance) are active and Apple's licence does not cover this decoder
